 INTERNSHIPS 
Data Analytics & AI Intern | National Institute of Electronics & Information Technology, Calicut 2025 
Completed a 4-week internship in Data Analytics and Artificial Intelligence at NIELIT, where I worked on an AI-based Online 
Exam Cheating Detection System.The system used computer vision techniques to monitor candidate behavior during online 
exams.YOLO-based object detection was applied to identify prohibited items and multiple persons.Screen activity was also 
tracked to detect tab switching and abnormal behavior.This experience strengthened my skills in AI, data analysis, and real-
world problem solving. 
 
 PROJECTS 
Exam Cheating Detection System: 2025 
The Online Exam Cheating Detection System is an AI -powered proctoring solution that ensures fairness and integrity in 
remote examinations. It continuously monitors candidates in real time using computer vision to analyze eye gaze, mouth 
movements, and head pose to identify suspicious behaviors. The system uses YOLO -based object detection to detect 
prohibited items, multiple persons, and unauthorized devices in the exam environment. Integrated with screen monitoring, it 
also detects tab switching and abnormal activity, enabling secure, automated, and reliable online examinations. 
 
Online Leave Management System – Automated Employee Leave Tracking and Approval Platform: 2025 
The Online Leave Management System is a Spring Boot web application using PostgreSQL for data storage. It allows 
employees to apply for leave online, while managers and admins can approve or reject requests based on leave balance and 
reasons. The system ensures transparency, accurate tracking, and secure role-based access for efficient leave management. 
 
SignSense – AI-Based Hand Sign Recognition with Video Call Integration: 2025 
SignSense is an AI-powered communication system that bridges the gap between hearing individuals and those with speech 
or hearing impairments. It detects hand signs in real time using computer vision, translates them into text, and converts the 
text into speech. Integrated with a live video call interface, it enables inclusive and accessible conversations. Key features 
include a custom-trained sign language dataset, real-time recognition, text-to-speech conversion, and smart reply suggestions 
for non-signing users. 
 
CERTIFICATIONS
